T3_about.h2: What is MAGLUMI X3 and who is it for?
T3_about.text: MAGLUMI X3 is a compact, fully automated Snibe analyzer for chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) testing. It processes up to 200 tests per hour and occupies less than 0.68 m², making it suitable for laboratories with moderate workloads and limited floor space.

items.text: With a footprint below 0.68 m², the analyzer fits laboratories where floor space is constrained.
A Teflon-coated pipetting needle is designed to reduce carryover, and each reaction takes place in an individual cup.
The incubation temperature is 37 ± 0.3 °C, according to the manufacturer.
Samples, reagents and consumables are loaded from the front. Indicator lights show their status and the instrument status.

testMenu.h2: Which tests can MAGLUMI X3 perform?
testMenu.title: MAGLUMI CLIA test menu
testMenu.text: Thyroid, tumor, infectious disease and cardiac markers, among others. Ask a LabWell manager about the availability of individual tests in Ukraine.
